director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj fractions ko cricket ke equal shares se dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan
Achha, Riya! Cricket pasand hai. Socho, ek paratha 4 players mein barabar baanta—har player ko kitna hissa milega? Golu ko bhi sikhaoge.
step by step samjhao
Haan Riya, dheere chalenge. Pehla step: shape ko barabar parts mein baanto. Agar 3 barabar parts hain, har part ko one-third kehte hain. Riya, 3 parts ginogi?
chhota bolo
Theek hai, Riya—chhota step: 1/3 mein 1 liya gaya part batata hai. Tum bolo, 1 kya batata hai?
pehle picture dikhao
Riya, imagine ek poora circle 3 barabar parts mein baanta hai; 1 part rangin hai. Rangin parts kitne hain?
pata nahi
Koi baat nahi, Riya. Rangin parts 1 hain—isi liye fraction ka upar wala number 1 hai. Neeche wala number kya batayega?
kuch aur baat karte hain
Haan Riya, lesson ek minute ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karni hai? Phir fraction par lautenge.
cricket ke baare mein
Cricket mein fielders equal groups jaise hote hain—sab apni jagah sambhalte hain. Tumhe batting pasand hai ya bowling?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: hindi mein batao
Cricket mein gendbaaz gend phenkte hain, aur ballebaaz run banata hai. Riya, tumhe ballebaazi pasand hai ya gendbaazi?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: mujhe khud try karne do
Theek hai, Riya—pehle tum khud try karo. Batao: ek-tihai mein 1, kitne barabar hisson mein se hai?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: 1/3 means 1 of ___ equal groups.

director.text: bye
Theek hai Riya, tum rukna chahti ho—hum jaari rakh sakte hain, chhota break le sakte hain, ya aaj rok sakte hain. Tumhari choice kya hai?
